page: Amazon Web Services m8gd.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine powered by the AWS Nitro hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on the 64-bit ARMv9 architecture, utilizing the AWS Neoverse-V2 processor running at 2.8 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. Local storage is bundled as a 1900 GB NVMe SSD instance store volume, and the network interface delivers a baseline bandwidth of 15 Gbps.

Benchmark data highlights top-tier memory performance, with large-block read-only memory bandwidth reaching 363.94 GB/sec and write bandwidth at 182.89 GB/sec. The system achieves a top-tier Geekbench multi-core score of 21404.0 and excels in database operations, scoring 47242.75 on Passmark. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and software compilation with clang demonstrate strong performance, while single-core operations and LLM inference tasks generally fall within the average range.

The ARM64 architecture and dedicated core allocation provide high resource density and predictable execution without hyperthreading overhead. Bundling local NVMe SSD storage directly with the instance improves qualitative cost efficiency for IOPS-heavy workloads by eliminating external block storage overhead. This server is optimized for database hosting, Redis caching, multi-threaded software compilation, and general-purpose web serving.
